vulnerability_analysis: The setClaimRewardAsTokensPercentage function lacks access control. It only validates percentage ≤ 100 but doesn't check if caller is owner, allowing any address to set their own percentage to 100%.
attack_strategy: Directly call the vulnerable function as the attacker to set claimRewardAsTokensPercentage to 100%
step_by_step_plan: 1. Impersonate owner to activate contract. 2. Give attacker LLG tokens to meet minRewardBalance. 3. Call setClaimRewardAsTokensPercentage(100) as attacker. 4. Verify percentage is 100.
